posts.title: COSMIC on Pop_OS!
posts.description: Thoughts on using COSMIC on Pop_OS! 24.04 for a day: All of the apps are super fast. It's a noticeable, I'd almost say drastic, change from Pop OS 22.04. It's buggy. Not unusable buggy but there are things here and there.
